The arc ran: critical-review gate (no report existed for ancora, so a fresh 9-persona review ran), rebase (no-op, main is a direct ancestor), then local CI preflight against BOTH matrix legs. Preflight found two blockers, so the pipeline stopped before /open-pr per Stop condition 7.

BLOCKER 1 - deterministic. mix spec.check --base ecc5e24 (main) exits non-zero: spec.check result=fail tier=branch errors=0 warnings=1, on ancora.review derived/growth. CI smoke runs that exact command for a PR into main, so the PR would be red 100% of runs. Cause: .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md changed by exactly one line on this branch (status draft -> active) while ~1000 lines of review code landed. The tool is correct; the contract was never substantively updated. Filed as ancora-ayj.
  Root gap: every per-ticket gate in this epic ran --base against a recent incremental base, never against the actual PR base. 34 children closed green and the branch still fails its own gate against main.

BLOCKER 2 - probabilistic. Full suite fails ~1 run in 5 on a quiet machine; two CI legs per push means ~36% chance of a red test job. Two independent root causes reproduced: capture_io(:stderr) cross-talk between async:true modules (deterministic at --seed 4), and cross-VM temp-path collisions (Ancora.TempName.cross_vm_suffix/0 exists for exactly this and is unused). Filed as ancora-rdx.

GREEN in preflight: both matrix legs compile with --warnings-as-errors, mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused. Elixir 1.19.5/OTP 28 and 1.18.4/OTP 26 both build clean.

Critical review: 9 personas (data excluded - no database surface anywhere; every "ecto" hit is the substring inside "detector"). 100 raw findings -> 81 unique -> 66 calibrated, 42 severity adjustments, 25 consensus. ZERO critical, 7 high. Disposition 58 fix-now / 8 tracked / 15 dropped. Report:
